h1: Every term a trader needs to know.

title: FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) | PropLogAI Glossary
description: FOMO in trading is the pressure to enter because a move appears to be leaving without you, even though part of your written plan is incomplete or has changed.

title: Revenge Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Revenge trading is a post-loss decision pattern in which recovering the lost money becomes the purpose of the next trade and part of the written plan changes or is ignored.

title: Tilt in Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Tilt in trading is a period when frustration, anger or pressure appears beside a change from the process written before the decision.

title: Confirmation Bias in Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Confirmation bias in trading is the tendency to search for, notice or interpret information in a way that supports an existing trade idea.

title: Loss Aversion | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Loss aversion in trading means the fear of a loss or giving back a gain may influence a decision more strongly than an equivalent gain.

title: Overconfidence in Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Overconfidence in trading is confidence that appears beside a decision to change or ignore a rule written before the trade.

title: Drawdown | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Drawdown is the amount an account falls from an earlier high to a later value. A prop firm drawdown limit is a separate rule that sets an official account floor.

title: Position Sizing | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Position sizing is the calculation used to choose trade size so the estimated loss at the planned stop matches your chosen USD risk and exact account rules.

title: Risk-Reward Ratio | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A comparison between the loss planned at your stop and the gain planned at your target, commonly written as 1:2 or 1:3.

title: Stop Loss | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A planned exit level or order instruction used to close a trade after a price trigger; the actual fill can differ from the stop price.

title: Risk Per Trade | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Risk per trade is the loss amount planned before one trade if the exit fills near the expected price. It is not a guaranteed maximum or a universal percentage.

title: Win Rate | PropLogAI Glossary
description: The percentage of closed trades counted as wins in one defined sample.

title: Profit Factor | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Total gross profit divided by the absolute value of total gross loss for a defined set of closed trades.

title: Expectancy | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Trading expectancy is the average net result per trade in one defined historical sample. It does not predict the next trade.

title: Sharpe Ratio | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A historic Sharpe ratio compares average return above a defined baseline with how much those returns varied during the same period.

title: Average Win vs Average Loss | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Average win is the total winning result divided by winning trades; average loss is the total losing result divided by losing trades in the same defined sample.

title: Equity Curve | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A trading equity curve is a line showing how a defined account value changes across time or trade order. Check whether it includes only closed results or also open profit and loss.

title: Trading Plan | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A trading plan is a written framework prepared before trading that says what you may trade, when you may act, what conditions must be present, how risk and exits are planned, and what you will record afterward.

title: Setup Compliance | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Setup compliance checks whether a recorded trade matched the setup conditions written before entry. It checks the decision record, not whether the trade won or lost.

title: Overtrading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Overtrading means moving away from the trading process written before the decision, such as taking extra entries, extending the session, weakening the setup or changing size.

title: Pre-Market Routine | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A pre-market routine is a short sequence you complete before your planned trading session so the setup, account rules, risk and no-trade conditions are written before you consider an entry.

title: Trade Management | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Trade management means the decisions and actions taken after a position opens and before it is fully closed, compared with the management rules written before entry.

title: Rule-Based Trading | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Rule-based trading means making trading decisions with conditions written before the moment of action and clear enough to check later from the record.

title: Prop Firm Challenge | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A prop firm challenge is an evaluation stage with a program-specific rule sheet. Reaching the profit target alone may not complete every condition.

title: Funded Trading Account | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A funded trading account is a prop-firm account stage offered under an agreement. The word funded does not by itself prove that the account uses live capital.

title: Overall Drawdown Limit | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An overall drawdown limit is the lowest account value allowed across the account period. The official floor may stay fixed or move under the program rules.

title: Profit Target | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A prop-firm profit target is the net-profit objective for a specific evaluation phase. It is one condition in the full rule set.

title: Consistency Rule | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A consistency rule checks whether too much of your total profit came from one day or one trade. Your firm decides the formula, limit, and what happens when you are over it.

title: Daily Drawdown Limit | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A daily drawdown limit is the official account floor that applies during one firm-defined trading day. Some firms call it maximum daily loss.

title: Trading Journal | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A trading journal records what you planned, what you actually did, and what happened, so the decision can be checked separately from the profit or loss.

title: Trade Review | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A trade review is a post-trade check that compares the written plan with the actual execution, confirms the recorded result, and ends with one evidence-based observation.

title: Emotion Tracking | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Emotion tracking means recording a short feeling tag beside a specific trading moment and the observable decision that followed. The feeling is context; it does not prove what caused the result.

title: Pattern Recognition | PropLogAI Glossary
description: Pattern recognition in a trading journal means finding the same recorded combination across a defined group of trades. It is a clue to inspect, not proof of what caused the result.

title: Trading Performance Report | PropLogAI Glossary
description: A trading performance report summarises trades from one clearly defined period using records you can check. It keeps financial results separate from the process details you recorded.

title: AI Trading Coach | PropLogAI Glossary
description: An AI trading coach reviews a trader’s own recorded journal data and returns summaries, questions or possible patterns for the trader to verify against the original records.
